reason: It's free this month so I might connect my Instagram and look around, but I'm not committing to the ₹499 pass. My WhatsApp groups already send me collab leads for nothing, and I've seen these apps launch with zero businesses on them.
objection: Will there actually be Bengaluru cafés and brands on it who want a Kannada creator my size, or is it empty like the other apps? Beta, small team, and 'brands join free' doesn't tell me any of them have actually joined.
would_change_my_mind: Getting one real paid collab through Mitra in the free month, not barter, from a local business that came to me because of my Kannada content.
